$comment: SITE EDIT FILE FOR THE LEGAL PAGES (Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy). The words of each document live in their own .md file in this SiteEdit folder; this file names those files and styles both pages the same way. Groups run from the top of the page downward. Inside a group: the words first, then that text's font and font size, then its colour with its opacity on the very next line. Font: 'default' keeps the site's look, or a name from the font list in the README. Font size: 'default', or a size such as 1.1rem. Keep every comma and quotation mark; check the file with a JSON validator before saving.

pages.$comment: ONE ENTRY PER LEGAL PAGE. The entry's name is the page's web address: terms is gracefulfashion.com.ng/terms, privacy is gracefulfashion.com.ng/privacy, and it is also the name used in links written as [Words](terms). Use small letters and dashes only, and don't rename one that is already linked. titleText: the big title. file: the .md file in this SiteEdit folder. effectiveDateText and lastUpdatedText show under the title; leave one as "" to hide it. When the law or the business changes, edit the .md file and update the date here. To add a page (for example a returns policy), copy a whole { ... } entry, give it a new name and file, then link to it with [Returns Policy](returns).

heading.$comment: THE BAND AT THE TOP OF BOTH PAGES: a small label, the page title, then the dates. Leave smallLabelText as "" to hide the label.

contents.$comment: THE CONTENTS LIST of numbered sections, made automatically from every line in the .md file that starts with ## . On a computer it sits beside the document and stays in view while scrolling; on a phone or tablet it is a folded box above the document that opens with a tap.

document.$comment: THE DOCUMENT ITSELF. sectionHeadings are lines starting with ## (with a thin line above each), smallHeadings are lines starting with ###, body is all ordinary text, lists and tables. bold is text written between **double stars**. links are web addresses, email addresses and [Words](link) inside the document. table colours are for tables written with | lines.

backToTop.$comment: THE BACK TO TOP LINK at the end of the document.
